name: Solidago canadensis flower extract
description: Solidago canadensis flower extract (CAS 96690-40-3 ), commonly known as Goldenrod extract, is derived from the flowering tops of the Canadian goldenrod plant. It is used across cosmetic, nutraceutical, and pharmaceutical formulations for its antioxidant and flavoring properties. It functions primarily as a botanical active and natural stabilizer in finished product development. In personal care and cosmetics, Goldenrod extract is incorporated into skin-conditioning creams, toners, and anti-aging serums. Its antioxidant activity supports oxidative stability and supports claims around botanical-derived actives. Nutraceutical manufacturers use it in dietary supplement capsules and herbal blends targeting urinary tract and inflammatory wellness positioning. In food and beverage applications, it contributes mild floral and herbaceous flavor notes to functional teas, botanical beverages, and natural flavor systems. Pharmaceutical formulators source it as a standardized botanical ingredient. This extract is used for inclusion in herbal medicinal products where consistent extract quality is a procurement requirement. Solidago canadensis flower extract is supplied as a dry powder or liquid extract. Dry forms are the most common for supplement and cosmetic manufacturing. Standard grades include cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications, with some suppliers offering standardized extracts defined by flavonoid or rutin content. Bulk supply is available in kilogram and multi-kilogram quantities to suit both development-scale and commercial production volumes.
